description: Figure 8(c) illustrates the Branching Ratio γB metric of a reasoning graph across different numbers of few-shot examples. The chart has a horizontal axis labeled "Number of Shots" with categories ranging from 0 to 4 in integer steps, and a vertical axis labeled with a symbol that appears to be the Greek letter xi (ξ), with a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.24 in increments of 0.04. The bars are grouped into two categories, "Incorrect" and "Correct", represented by different colors, with "Incorrect" on top and "Correct" on the bottom. The "Incorrect" bars have approximate values of 0.14, 0.12, 0.11, 0.10, and 0.10 for 0 to 4 shots, respectively, while the "Correct" bars have approximate values of 0.07, 0.08, 0.08, 0.08, and 0.08 for 0 to 4 shots, respectively. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and there is no visual emphasis on any specific bar. Overall, the chart displays the distribution of Branching Ratio γB for both "Incorrect" and "Correct" categories across varying numbers of few-shot examples.
